prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a moody, high-contrast black and white photograph set in a dimly lit, industrial or utilitarian interior. The main focus is a metallic panel on the left, featuring Swedish text engraved in a clean, sans-serif font, with a tactile button or indicator below. Adjacent to the panel, a bold, graphic warning sign dominates the right side of the composition. The sign depicts a stylized, mid-century comic book-style illustration of a person in mid-air, dramatically flung backward as a door swings open, conveying a sense of sudden motion and danger. The figure’s expression is one of surprise or alarm, with limbs splayed and clothing rendered in dynamic, angular lines. The word “VARNING” is prominently displayed in large, capitalized letters at the bottom of the sign, further emphasizing the cautionary message. The overall scene is shot with a shallow depth of field, focusing sharply on the sign and panel while the background recedes into deep shadow. The lighting is stark and directional, casting hard-edged highlights and deep shadows, enhancing the sense of tension and urgency. The visual style is reminiscent of noir photography, with a gritty, documentary feel and a strong emphasis on graphic elements and dramatic contrasts.
